# Rapier 3D compat 0.21.0

Official `@dimforge/rapier3d-compat` ESM distribution, including embedded WebAssembly, copied without code changes from npm (2026-10-18).

- Source: https://github.com/dimforge/rapier
- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/@dimforge/rapier3d-compat/-/rapier3d-compat-0.21.0.tgz
- License: Apache-2.0, included as `LICENSE`.
- Kept local so physics initialization does not depend on an external CDN. Existing Three.js loading is unchanged.
